info.name: 46. Cross-document — Change-order and out-of-scope detection
info.description: POST /query rewrites the question, decomposes it into a DAG, and streams one JSON object per line (application/x-ndjson). Each line is {"id", "response", "references"}.

request.description: query is required. conversation_history is optional; omit it or send [] when there is no prior turn.
